description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性。
description.en: A unique, client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no longer than 64 characters. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence.
